notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Rover Mechanics! [/h1]

[h3][b]New update for Rover Mechanic Simulator is now live![/b][/h3]

This patch contains some of the fixes and improvements based on your feedback and reports since the full release launch! For the full patch notes/changelog see below:

[h3][u]Changelog:[/u][/h3]
- Searchbox text bug has been fixed.
- Text spacing in menu has been corrected.
- Saving bug has been fixed.
- Translations have been corrected.
- Rare soldering freeze has been fixed.
- Amount of resources for premium tasks have been increased.
- [b]Possibility to disable mouse acceleration has been added.[/b]

You may find the previous changelogs in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/discussions/0/1745644671661197026/]this forum thread[/url].

[url=discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Remember that the [b]Community Group Challenge[/b] is still on, and we're still working on adding more content! Let’s unlock the next two goals!

notes.title: Easter Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

We've prepared a little surprise for you to celebrate Easter Holidays. Inside the hangar, you can find some furry companions that will assist you during the repairs. [b]Count how many Easter Rabbits we've put in the game, and let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/35dda2a]Discord server[/url], before the 14th of April.[/b] Most perceptive engineers will also find out how to interact with the bunny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/2e1d430895a5a932d775d3215be106ba00882e67.png[/img]

[b]We will announce the correct answer and the winners on the 14th of April.[/b] The 5 people who will give the correct answer first will be awarded with a small prize, but it’ll be a surprise! Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/35dda2a]Discord server[/url], if you haven’t already. 

Good luck and have fun! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/cd4d81d3b758bd75727771d05e264e7eb7da722f.png[/img]

[b]Happy tinkering during Easter Holidays! Stay safe, take care of yourself, and eat as many chocolate bunnies as you want. [/b]

Best Regards, 
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Translations Update and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Martians! [/h1]

[b]Update 0.3.4.5 for Rover Mechanic Simulator is now live! [/b]

This big update contains bug fixes and additional changes. It also introduces languages that have been added to the game.  

[b]For the full patch notes/changelog see below: [/b]

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]
[list] [*] Problem with game freeze when you clean panels after completing mission H-8468 has been fixed.
[*] Bug with swapping parts on PCBs has been fixed
[*] Problem with controls reset to default when leaving the game has been fixed
[*] Fixed an issue where the "place lift here" text is not disappearing after cancelling the action.
[*] Bug with resistorE on IC_6 PCB has been fixed.
[*] Problem with picking up capsules from a 3D printer and then pausing makes the capsules spin around has been fixed.
[*] Problem with the camera while working on the workbench has been fixed.
[*] Problem with the airlock sound triggering without airlock moving has been fixed.
[*] Problem with adding skill points on high screen resolutions has been solved.
[*] Problem with the weather forecast board showing improper sol has been fixed.
[*] Problem with triggering the sound without placing a lift has been fixed.
[*] Problem with seeing the damage on uncleaned parts has been fixed.
[*] Tablet button animation jittering bug has been fixed.
[*] Problem with discrepancies in assembly/disassembly has been fixed. 
[*] Typos have been corrected. [/list]

[u]List of improvements:[/u] 
[list] [*] Salvaging incomplete sets is now possible.
[*] The scissors lift is placed permanently in the middle of the hangar.
[*] Support for ultrawide monitors with 21:9 aspect ratio has been added.
[*] Game Engine updated to newer version.
[*] Completed quests can be repeated. [/list]

[u] Added Localizations: [/u]
[list] [*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Polish 
[*] German 
[*] Russian
[*] French [/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xOPhQcl.png[/img]

Remember that you can follow bug reports on our special public [url=https://trello.com/b/swF8btEd/rms-public-bugtracker]public Trello Board[/url]. More information about how to report a problem [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/discussions/0/1745644504176029798/]can be found here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sOri7hm.png[/img]

More updates and new content will follow later so stay tuned! 

Best regards,
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

P.S. remember to also add our upcoming game to your wishlists (if you haven't already) ;)

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Martians! [/h1]

Thank you very much for the warm welcome to our game on Steam. We are delighted to see that you like the game so far!

We appreciate all of your feedback. We'd like to especially thank the players who were so active on our [url=https://discord.gg/94ttuGJ]Discord server[/url]. Your help with tracking some bugs was invaluable and it let us fix them very quickly!

In the first patch (which is now live!) you will find:

[b]UPDATE 0.3.4.4 (10 Feb 2020):[/b]
[list]
[*]Order rewards have been balanced better
[*]Problems with "Trained Eye" skill have been solved
[*]Autosave added to the beginning and end of each order
[*]Bug with calculating statistics after canceling printing has been fixed
[*]Bug with missing material on APXS and Sojurner Camera has been fixed
[*]Bug with not loading tutorial save in some circumstances has been fixed
[*]Bug with freezing after quick switching between cleaning and repairing on workbench has been fixed
[/list]

We have also created a separate [b]public_test_branch[/b] on Steam, if you are interested in helping us with the development and being the first to test the new versions! Please keep in mind however, that this will be an "unstable branch" so remember to backup your save files before switching to it (just in case).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/de66e04bca431ee77c245dd240863d4e33785472.png[/img]

Additionally - a special [url=https://trello.com/b/swF8btEd/rms-public-bugtracker]public Trello Board[/url] was created where you can follow all the reported bugs. More information about how to report a problem [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/864680/discussions/0/1745644504176029798/]can be found here[/url].

Our plan is to continue updating the game for you. Stay tuned for more updates! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/5a052a2a71c1f2c3541af10756b812428215705c.png[/img]
